title: Glyph reserve brief: compact GPU pool controls & burst tuning widget
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, glanceable widget for the Redwood Console that surfaces per-GPU-pool health, current autoscale state, and a small set of burst controls. The widget ("Glyph Reserve") will be used on pool overview rows and in a compact inspector panel. Goal: enable on-call and SRE users to triage reserve pressure and apply quick bursts without opening the full pool editor.
acceptance_criteria: Widget shows 3-second-refresh health snapshot: CPU/GPU utilization, memory pressure, and pending queue length
Clear indication of current autoscale policy name and effective replica count
Burst control (Quick + / Quick -) that triggers preset burst intents with confirmation modal and shows cooldown timer
Fallback / degrade state when telemetry is delayed (>30s) with actionable CTA to open full pool page
Accessibility: 4.5:1 contrast for critical badges, keyboard-navigable controls, screen-reader labels for burst actions
Component library tokens used; responsive across row and inspector sizes; component spec added to Figma and React repo PR linked
review_feedback: 2026-02-25 - Jordan (PM): Love the compact state but request to expose 'last successful scale' timestamp and reason (autoscaler/override/manual).
2026-02-27 - Nisha (Eng): Need to ensure 'quick burst' maps to the same audit/log pipeline as manual bursts; include a non-blocking spinner while API confirms the intent.
2026-03-02 - Sam (Design Ops): Suggest reducing primary CTA weight for quick burst to avoid accidental clicks; confirm keyboard shortcut and ARIA danger role for confirm modal.
2026-03-09 - Lina (SRE): Add an 'estimated cost delta' tooltip for each burst preset based on current price sheet; essential for ops teams with budget constraints.
decisions: Compact view will show aggregated GPU utilization rather than per-GPU metrics to preserve horizontal space in pool rows
Burst presets are configurable at pool level (backend) but the widget will surface only the top-3 presets; deep edits go to pool settings page
Telemetry stale threshold set to 30s for widget; stale state shows amber strip with 'data delayed' and a 'refresh' action
We will defer adding live tokenized cost breakdown to the compact widget; show heuristic cost delta tooltip instead (labelled 'estimate')
